messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Control plane 5xx spike detected — gateway 502/504s rising to 12% across US-west/US-east. Affected endpoints: /v1/auth/*, /v1/orgs/lookup, billing/charge. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123

Jordan (oncall-eng): ACK — I'm on it. Looking at traces now. @Sam can you join? Paging SRE.

Sam (sre): oncall here, joining. seeing a sharp increase in org-lookup 5xx and timeouts from config-service. traces show retries to config: `config-service.v3.internal:443 -> 504` and increased latency on auth cache miss.

Jordan (oncall-eng): Repro steps from gateway logs:
```
[2026-03-15T02:05:12Z] GET /v1/orgs/lookup 502 upstream_error config-service timeout
[2026-03-15T02:05:13Z] POST /v1/auth/token 504 upstream_timeout auth-proxy
```

Sam (sre): Rolling deploy to config-service finished ~02:00z per deploy bot — Dev-Deploy-Bot shows `deploy/config-service@v2.14.0` -> `v2.15.0`. Suspect bad config change. Checking env diff.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: deploy/config-service-v2.15.0 succeeded at 2026-03-15T02:00:07Z (CI: #1456)

Jordan (oncall-eng): Maria (pm) ping — customer impact? Any high priority tenants reported? :eyes:

Maria (pm): Receiving CS tickets for API errors from 3 enterprise customers, volume small but errors hitting product workflows. They're seeing 502s on auth & org lookup calls during signups.

Sam (sre): Quick mitigation suggestions:
- rollback config-service to v2.14.0
- enable gateway fallback to cached org-lookup (ttl-based) for 5m
- increase config-service replicas from 4 -> 8 and throttle burst queue

Jordan (oncall-eng): I'll trigger rollback if we confirm deploy is culprit. Sam, can you flip the gateway fallback first to reduce customer impact?

Sam (sre): Doing gateway fallback now: `curl -XPOST https://api-gateway/admin/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/orgs/lookup","mode":"cache-first","ttl":300}'`

Sam (sre): ✅ fallback applied. Observability: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 6% in 90s. Traces show fewer roundtrips to config.

Jordan (oncall-eng): Good. Maria please update CS with ETA and mitigation note: fallback applied, rolling rollback next.

Maria (pm): Noted. Sending template note to customers now. Will escalate to enterprise success for affected tenants.

Sam (sre): Initiating rollback to v2.14.0 now via deploy bot.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: rollback/config-service -> v2.14.0 started (triggered by Sam). Estimated finish 30s.

Dev-Deploy-Bot: rollback/config-service -> v2.14.0 completed at 2026-03-15T02:08:31Z

Jordan (oncall-eng): Observability check: 5xx down to 1.2% global, latency normalizing. Looks like deploy caused regression. Will keep gateway fallback for 10 minutes, then remove if stable.

Priya (oncall-next): taking handoff at 02:15Z — I'll own post-rollback monitoring and follow-up. Jordan handing off.

Jordan (oncall-eng): Handoff: root cause likely bad config validation in v2.15.0 affecting cache warmup and increasing upstream timeouts. Action items: write postmortem, add deploy gating for config change, add smoke tests for org-lookup path. Priya, ping me if it regresses.

Priya (oncall-next): ACK. I'll keep eyes on SLOs and update incident channel in 15m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved annotation pending triage. Tags: controlplane, deploy-regression, rollback, customer-impact
